actors.title: Project Manager
actors.description: Owns project setup, budget oversight, task planning, change orders, and status reporting for one or more jobs. Reviews and shares status reports with clients and controls task status updates.

actors.title: Field Worker
actors.description: Receives assigned work tasks and records daily time and progress from the field via a mobile-friendly interface. Can update task status for tasks assigned to them.

actors.title: Billing Staff
actors.description: Prepares and reviews client billing summaries and invoices from approved job cost and change-order data. Shares billing documents with clients.

actors.title: Client
actors.description: External customer who receives shared project status reports and billing summaries. Has limited read-only visibility with no ability to edit projects or create billing documents.

rules.title: Project activation requires core fields
rules.description: A project must have a name, client, and site address before it can be activated; activation is forbidden when any of these fields is missing.
sourceJourneyRules: A project must have a name, client, and site address before it can be activated.

rules.title: Job costing requires budget and schedule dates
rules.description: Budget and schedule dates must be present on a project before job costing tracking can begin; without them, cost aggregation is not permitted.
sourceJourneyRules: Budget and schedule dates are required to begin job costing tracking.

rules.title: Field entries, tasks, and change orders require an active project
rules.description: A project must be in active status before field entries can be recorded, tasks can be created, or change orders can be issued; inactive projects block all three operations.
sourceJourneyRules: Project status controls whether field entries can be recorded against the project.
Tasks must belong to an active project.
Change orders can only be created on active projects.

rules.title: A task is assigned to one field worker at a time
rules.description: A work task can only be assigned to a single field worker at any given time; concurrent multiple assignments are forbidden.
sourceJourneyRules: A task can only be assigned to one field worker at a time.

rules.title: Task due dates must fall within the project schedule window
rules.description: A work task due date must fall within the project's schedule start and end dates; due dates outside the schedule window are not permitted.
sourceJourneyRules: Due dates should fall within the project schedule window.

rules.title: Dashboard defaults to active projects only
rules.description: The operational dashboard must show only active projects by default; inactive or completed projects are excluded from the default view.
sourceJourneyRules: Dashboard shows only active projects by default.

rules.title: Job costs and budget-vs-actual are derived from time logs, material usage, and approved change orders
rules.description: Budget-vs-actual figures and job cost totals must be derived exclusively from labor time logs, material usage entries, and approved change orders; no other sources contribute to these calculations.
sourceJourneyRules: Budget vs actual is derived from labor time logs, material usage, and approved change orders.
Job costs are derived from time logs, material usage, and approved change orders.

rules.title: Overdue tasks are highlighted by due date comparison
rules.description: Work tasks whose due date has passed must be highlighted as overdue on the dashboard, based on a comparison of the task due date against the current date.
sourceJourneyRules: Overdue tasks are highlighted based on due date comparison.

rules.title: Change order must describe scope, cost, or schedule impact
rules.description: A change order must include a description of its scope, cost, or schedule impact; a change order without any of these descriptions cannot be created.
sourceJourneyRules: A change order must describe the scope, cost, or schedule impact.

rules.title: Only approved change orders affect job costing, billing, and invoicing
rules.description: Only change orders in approved status may influence job costing totals, be included in billing summaries, or appear as line items on invoices; pending or rejected change orders are excluded from all three.
sourceJourneyRules: Only approved change orders affect job costing and billing.
Billing summaries include only approved change orders.
Only approved change orders can be included in an invoice.

rules.title: Status report content is generated from live project data via the LLM proxy
rules.description: Status report content must be generated from live project tasks, time logs, and material usage data through the platform LLM proxy; stale or manually authored content is not the generation source.
sourceJourneyRules: Status report content is generated from live project tasks, time logs, and material usage via the platform LLM proxy.

rules.title: Delay-risk suggestions are advisory only
rules.description: Delay-risk suggestions generated by the AI are advisory and must not automatically change any task status; they require human action to take effect.
sourceJourneyRules: Delay-risk suggestions are advisory and do not automatically change task status.

rules.title: Project manager controls status report generation, review, and sharing
rules.description: Status reports are generated and shared by the project manager, who can review and edit the report content before sharing it with the client; no other actor may share reports directly.
sourceJourneyRules: The project manager can review and edit the report before sharing with the client.
Status reports are generated and shared by the project manager.

rules.title: Field workers see only their assigned tasks
rules.description: A field worker may only view work tasks that are assigned to them; tasks assigned to other workers are hidden from their view.
sourceJourneyRules: Field workers see only tasks assigned to them.

rules.title: Tasks are sorted by due date for urgency surfacing
rules.description: Work tasks displayed to field workers must be sorted by due date so that the most urgent work appears first in the list.
sourceJourneyRules: Tasks are sorted by due date to surface the most urgent work first.

rules.title: Mobile experience must be usable without desktop access
rules.description: The field worker experience must be fully usable on a mobile device in the field without requiring desktop access; all core task and logging operations must work on mobile.
sourceJourneyRules: The mobile experience must be usable in the field without desktop access.

rules.title: Time logs must be linked to a task and worker
rules.description: Every time log must be linked to a specific work task and a specific worker; unlinked time logs are not permitted in the system.
sourceJourneyRules: Time logs must be linked to a specific task and worker.

rules.title: Material usage is recorded per project for job costing
rules.description: Material usage entries are recorded at the project level for job costing purposes and must not be treated as warehouse stock management; inventory tracking is out of scope.
sourceJourneyRules: Material usage is recorded per project for job costing, not as warehouse stock management.

rules.title: Task status can only be updated by assigned worker or project manager
rules.description: A work task status can only be updated by the field worker assigned to that task or by the project manager; all other actors are forbidden from changing task status.
sourceJourneyRules: Task status can only be updated by the assigned worker or the project manager.

rules.title: Billing summaries are client-facing and exclude internal cost codes
rules.description: Billing summaries presented to clients must exclude internal cost-code detail; only client-appropriate cost and change-order information is shown.
sourceJourneyRules: Billing summaries are client-facing and exclude internal cost-code detail.

rules.title: Invoices are billing documents; payment and accounting are external
rules.description: Invoices serve as billing documents for construction job costing only; payment capture and full accounting are handled outside the system and are not module responsibilities.
sourceJourneyRules: Invoices are billing documents for construction job costing; payment capture and full accounting remain external.
Payment processing and full accounting are handled outside the system.

rules.title: An invoice must reference the project and client
rules.description: Every invoice must reference both the project it belongs to and the client receiving the billing; invoices without these references cannot be created.
sourceJourneyRules: An invoice must reference the project and client.

rules.title: Client access is limited to status and billing surfaces
rules.description: Clients receive shared status reports and have visibility limited to status and billing communication surfaces only; they do not have full internal project editing access.
sourceJourneyRules: Clients receive shared status reports; they do not have full internal project editing access.
Client visibility is limited to status and billing communication surfaces.

rules.title: Clients can view but not edit billing documents
rules.description: Clients may see billing summaries and invoices shared by billing staff, but they cannot edit or create billing documents; all billing document authorship remains with billing staff.
sourceJourneyRules: Clients see billing summaries and invoices shared by billing staff.
Clients cannot edit or create billing documents.

mdm.title: Client registry
mdm.reason: Client identity and contact information are stable, rarely changing data that the platform MDM could own, referenced by projects, invoices, and billing summaries.

mdm.title: Material catalog
mdm.reason: Standard material definitions and units used in material usage entries could be maintained as MDM reference data rather than per-project definitions.

horizontals.title: Payments
horizontals.reason: Payment capture for invoices is explicitly out of scope for this module; a payments horizontal would handle transaction processing when integrated.

horizontals.title: Accounting
horizontals.reason: Full accounting and general ledger posting remain external to this module; an accounting horizontal would receive job cost and invoice data for bookkeeping.

plugins.title: Fiscal document export
plugins.reason: Invoices may need to be exported as fiscal documents (e.g., NF-e, electronic invoices) depending on jurisdiction; this is an optional integration.

plugins.title: Payment gateway (TEF)
plugins.reason: If payment capture is later integrated, a TEF or payment gateway plugin would handle the transaction; currently out of scope but referenced by the invoice journey.

agents.title: LLM status report generator
agents.reason: The generateStatusReport journey uses the platform LLM proxy to produce report content from live project tasks, time logs, and material usage data.

agents.title: LLM delay-risk advisor
agents.reason: The reviewDashboard journey surfaces AI-generated delay-risk suggestions that are advisory and do not automatically change task status, powered by the platform LLM proxy.
